transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me a little bit about what has been bothering you and what brings you in to see me today?

Hello doctor. Lately, I've been really struggling because I keep eating huge amounts of food in a very short period of time. It feels like I completely lose control and just can't stop myself once I start.
After these episodes of overeating, do you engage in any specific behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or excessive exercising?

I don't make myself throw up or use laxatives, but I do other things to prevent weight gain. Usually, I will completely stop eating and fast for a day or two after an episode. I also force myself to exercise for hours, pushing way past my physical limits even when my body is completely exhausted.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Binge-Eating Disorder, Bulimia Nervosa]. The patient confirmed engaging in compensatory behaviors (fasting and excessive exercise) to prevent weight gain following episodes of binge eating, which excludes Binge-Eating Disorder and points specifically toward Bulimia Nervosa.
